display_name: Dharma Raja Karthika Thirunal Rama Varma
one_line: Ruler of Travancore (1758–1798), who consolidated Marthanda Varma’s reforms, fortified the Nedumkotta, and defended his state while upholding the Padmanabha Dasa ideal.

appearance.age_look: Late 30s to early 40s, medium height, lean but sturdy build with the poised bearing of a cautious, thoughtful king.
appearance.face: Oval face with warm medium-brown Kerala complexion, straight nose, calm almond-shaped dark brown eyes with a steady gaze, neatly arched brows, a short well-kept moustache, and a composed default expression that mixes gentleness with quiet resolve.
appearance.hair: Thick black hair oiled and combed back into a small, neat low knot at the back of the head, the forehead clean; he wears a simple golden Kerala-style headband (a slim band with a small central leaf-shaped motif) resting just above the brow, no crown.
appearance.costume: He wears a traditional late-18th-century Travancore royal costume: a long-sleeved, thigh-length off-white cotton angarakha-style upper garment crossing over the chest and tied at the right side with subtle gold edging at the collar and cuffs, over a cream-colored mundu (dhoti) wrapped to the ankles with a wide golden kasavu border; a deep maroon silk upper-cloth/shalya with thin gold stripes is draped from his left shoulder across the torso and around the waist, functioning like a sash, and he is barefoot or in simple dark leather sandals; jewellery is restrained—a single thin gold chain with a small Vaishnavite pendant, one pair of small gold ear studs, and a narrow gold bangle on his right wrist, emphasizing pious simplicity rather than opulence.
appearance.signature: A rolled map of the Nedumkotta fortifications held in his left hand, bound with a red ribbon, and a simple steel talwar with a slightly curved blade and plain brass hilt sheathed at his left hip, symbolizing his role in planning and defense rather than battlefield bravado.

ref_desc: Dharma Raja Karthika Thirunal Rama Varma is a medium-brown, oval-faced Travancore king with black hair tied in a low knot and a slim gold headband, wearing an off-white angarakha, cream mundu with gold border, deep maroon shalya, minimal gold jewellery, carrying a rolled Nedumkotta map and a sheathed steel talwar, in a palette of off-white, cream, deep maroon, gold and dark brown.
sheet_prompt: Draw a full-body anime-style character sheet of Dharma Raja Karthika Thirunal Rama Varma: a dignified late-18th-century Travancore ruler in his late 30s to early 40s, medium height and lean, with a warm medium-brown Kerala complexion, oval face, calm almond-shaped dark brown eyes, straight nose, short neat moustache, and a composed, thoughtful expression. His thick black hair is oiled and combed back into a small low knot, with a slim golden Kerala-style headband featuring a tiny central leaf motif above his brow. He wears an off-white, long-sleeved, thigh-length angarakha-style upper garment that crosses the chest and ties on the right, edged subtly in gold at collar and cuffs, over a cream-colored ankle-length mundu with a wide golden kasavu border. A deep maroon silk shalya with thin gold stripes is draped from his left shoulder across his chest and around his waist like a sash. He is barefoot or in simple dark leather sandals, and his jewellery is minimal: a thin gold chain with a small Vaishnavite pendant, small gold ear studs, and a single narrow gold bangle on his right wrist. His signature items are a rolled map of the Nedumkotta fortifications bound with a red ribbon in his left hand and a plain steel talwar with a curved blade and brass hilt sheathed at his left hip, emphasizing him as a strategic, devout ruler. Use a restrained palette of off-white, cream, deep maroon, gold and dark brown, and present him from multiple angles with close-ups of face, hair, costume details, and his map and sword so the design can be redrawn consistently.
